items.q: was Pin Madera, he was the first one to arrange for the band.

ctx.x: .....no, no because the original, in that particular vein, that we were rehearsing, was Pin Madera, he was the first one to arrange for the band. Then one day Mario called ......
Where did Pin Madera come from? Was he a jazzman also or did he come from another latin band?
